item.title: New Gaelic Initiative Aims to Drive Jobs and Economic Growth Across Highland Communities
item.description: A new national initiative, Tog, has been launched to link Gaelic directly to jobs and economic growth, focusing investment on the communities where the language is strongest and supporting businesses, entrepreneurs and young people across the Highlands and Islands.The post New Gaelic Initiative Aims to Drive Jobs and Economic Growth Across Highland Communities appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: First Minister Warns of Existential Threat to Key Scottish Industries Without Urgent UK Government Action
item.description: First Minister John Swinney has warned the UK Government to act now or risk irreversible deindustrialisation, urging the removal of the Energy Profits Levy and stronger support for Scotland’s energy and whisky sectors as key industries face mounting pressures and long term threats.The post First Minister Warns of Existential Threat to Key Scottish Industries Without Urgent UK Government Action appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Candidate Welcomes Plan for Fairer Bills and Stronger Community Ownership
item.description: Energy costs remain a heavy burden for many Highland households, and the SNP’s renewed focus on local ownership and fairer pricing speaks directly to that pressure, offering a vision of cleaner power, stronger communities and a future shaped by those who live here.The post Candidate Welcomes Plan for Fairer Bills and Stronger Community Ownership appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Royal Enfield Marks Milestone Year With Strong Showing at MCL25
item.description: Royal Enfield’s strong showing at MCL25 gives riders across the UK an early glimpse of new models and colours for 2026, offering a lively start to the brand’s 125th year and signalling a busy season of celebrations and innovation ahead.The post Royal Enfield Marks Milestone Year With Strong Showing at MCL25 appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: New Dingwall Homes Open Their Doors on Regenerated Mill Street
item.description: Dingwall’s Mill Street has been transformed with new one bed social rent homes that meet rising local demand, reflecting Highland Council’s wider push to grow affordable housing and regenerate town centres while supporting construction jobs and long term community stability. The post New Dingwall Homes Open Their Doors on Regenerated Mill Street appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: ScotRail Adds Extra Seats and Services for Premier Sports Cup Final
item.description: Football supporters heading to Hampden this weekend will see extra trains and more seats on key ScotRail routes, ensuring safer and smoother journeys as the Premier Sports Cup Final brings large crowds into Glasgow for the match.The post ScotRail Adds Extra Seats and Services for Premier Sports Cup Final appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Moray Council Issues Christmas Warning Over Unsafe Battery Disposal
item.description: Moray residents are being warned about the rising fire risk from discarded batteries as Christmas brings a surge in new electronics, with local authorities urging proper recycling to protect waste crews, prevent dangerous fires and keep communities safe.The post Moray Council Issues Christmas Warning Over Unsafe Battery Disposal appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Councillor Says Highland Council has Been Forced into Levy Climbdown
item.description: Andrew Baxter says Highland Council’s approach to the Visitor Levy has reached a breaking point, with new flat rate powers exposing unanswered questions around transparency, consultation and delivery, and raising fresh concerns for businesses and communities across the Highlands. The post Councillor Says Highland Council has Been Forced into Levy Climbdown appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Report Shows Orkney 2025 Island Games Delivered Major Boost and Long Lasting Legacy
item.description: A new report shows the Orkney 2025 Island Games delivered millions to the local economy and left a strong sporting and community legacy, highlighting record attendance, major investment and the remarkable volunteer effort that defined the week.The post Report Shows Orkney 2025 Island Games Delivered Major Boost and Long Lasting Legacy appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: New Poll Puts SNP Out in Front as Labour Falls Behind
item.description: A new IPSOS poll places the SNP clearly ahead ahead of next year’s Holyrood election, with Labour falling sharply and Reform challenging for second place, alongside renewed majority support for independence among Scottish voters.The post New Poll Puts SNP Out in Front as Labour Falls Behind appeared first on The Highland Times.
